g.text: AI Artifact Certification Layer & 100% Zero-DB Architecture
C1 Manifest Linter: Valid YAML & metadata
C4 SCA CVE Scan: 0 known dependency flaws
🛡️ Velocity Cap: Max 5 counted runs / dev / day
Author Entra ID OID is hard-excluded from rating scores
3. Core Certification Engine & AI Evaluation Cluster
Hosted on Azure Container Apps (.NET 10) • Dynamic Health Scoring (DHS)
If total_invocations < 10 ➔ Reliability = null ➔ Composite is NOT computed
Badge pinned at Community tier with UI display: "Not yet enough data"
Trust Principle T2: Danger is never averaged away with synthetic high scores.
Automated Protocol, Benchmark & LLM Referee Gates
Strict JSON Schema parameter typing • Standard error envelopes (-32600)
Golden Benchmark Harness + Hidden Hold-Out Suite
50-200 Scenarios (Pass >= 95%) • Private test suite defeats hardcoded cheats
Score >= 90/100 • XML Delimiter Sandboxing stops prompt injection attacks
• Scenario A (v1.2 ➔ v1.3 Upgrade): 72-Hour Provisional Window; re-earns independently.
• Scenario B (SharePoint Direct Edit): Instant Revocation via ContentHash signature.
Asymmetric Policy: Immediate loss on gate fail, slow telemetry re-accumulation to re-enter.
SharePoint Online Data Foundation (100% Zero DB Cost)
Microsoft Graph API • Sites.Selected • Native M365 Storage
• Synchronized Lists: Artifacts, Reviews.csv, Telemetry.csv, AuditLog.csv
🔒 STRICT READ-ONLY PERMISSIONS FOR ALL HUMAN USERS
Write access exclusively granted to Backend Service Principal (Managed Identity)
6. Continuous Background Daemons & Anti-Tamper Security Watchdogs
Detects out-of-band SharePoint source tampering / UI edits
• Re-computes SHA-256 checksum of live SharePoint files & compares against ContentHash column.
🚨 ON HASH MISMATCH: Instant Badge Revocation + SECURITY_TAMPER_EVENT logged
• Dispatches Microsoft Graph Security Alert to SecOps + Flags artifact for forced re-publish.
Continuous Health Re-computation & Automated Trust Decay
• Re-evaluates live telemetry from Telemetry.csv & refreshes Dynamic Health Scores.
• TRUST PRINCIPLE T3 (CERTIFICATION DECAYS): Dead tools lose badges automatically.
• 45-Day Inactivity Warning: Automated Microsoft Graph email dispatched to author.
• 60-Day Auto-Expiration: Dead artifacts gracefully demoted without breaking local code.
Security Alert & Audit Log Notification Pipeline
Microsoft Graph API (Email) • Microsoft Teams Security Webhooks • SharePoint AuditLog.csv
⚡ Zero-Latency Event Dispatch on any tampering, crash spike, or safety gate violation
